name: La Piñata Taqueria
tagline: The yellow taco truck on Broadway that made the San Francisco Chronicle's Top Burritos in the Bay Area list. Crunchy suadero, two great salsas, big super burritos.
seoTitle: La Piñata Taqueria | Taco Truck & Burritos in Vallejo, CA
description: La Piñata Taqueria, a taco truck at 809 Broadway, Vallejo, CA. Super burritos, tacos, nachos, quesadillas and tortas. Rated 4.7 stars. Open Mon–Fri 11am–9pm. (707) 334-8381.
highlights: #6 on Yelp’s Top 100 Food Trucks in the US (2025)

about.title: Fresh ingredients. Big flavor. Fair prices.
body: La Piñata is a yellow lonchera parked at 809 Broadway, serving authentic Mexican food made with fresh, quality ingredients: tacos, tortas, quesadillas, nachos, super burritos and shrimp dishes, plus horchata and agua de jamaica.

In 2025 Yelp ranked us #6 on its all-time list of the Top 100 Food Trucks in the US, and the San Francisco Chronicle put us on its Top Burritos in the Bay Area list back in November 2022. Some of our customers drive in from San Francisco for it.
about.imageAlt: Plate of La Piñata street tacos

reviews.text: suadero super burrito 10/10 would recommend. best burrito i’ve had in a minute! my sister got a al pastor taco which was a also very good. solid salsa (red one is sooo good) and food comes with pickles veggies which i love. also jamaica and horchata are both great. the horchata has a little coconut flavor. we live in the city and this beats out the options there. i’d consider driving up for this food tysm <3
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: La Piñata has been my favorite taco truck in Vallejo for years. Even after moving away, I still compare every taco spot to this one.
reviews.author: Henry D.

reviews.text: This is by far the best burrito place in Vallejo hands down. In every bite of my steak and shrimp burrito you can taste the freshness of all the ingredients. He always gives me a free drink when I come. I can appreciate that level of consistent exceptional customer service. Highly Recommended La Piñata !!
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: I came here after hearing such great things about La Pinata's suadero burritos, and they did not disappoint at all! This is a food truck with incredibly kind, hardworking staff…
reviews.author: Lynn N.

reviews.text: La Piñata is so good. I come from San Francisco for it and always get it when I’m in the area. The owner and staff have amazing customer service and the food is always good and fresh. I don’t usually leave reviews but it’s worth it. My go to is the chicken and shrimp burrito and the steak and shrimp nachos. Chefs kiss!
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Monster sized burritos, satisfying eats, actual REAL avocado slices instead of weird guacamole, lots and lots of outdoor seating, plus, ...wait for it.....access to an INDOOR restroom…
reviews.author: Echosaisis A.

reviews.text: Easily the best Taqueria in Vallejo NGL 🔥 2 Super Steak Burritos w/everything 2 Tacos-1 asada, 1 carnitas Didn't have to ask for extra sauce , customer service was A+ . 50 min drive was 100% worth it, will def be back
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: I got their lengua, cabeza and carnitas tacos. The most was so tender and flavorful. I don't feel like many do their lengua well, but theirs are definitely one of my favorites. Their salsas are both really good and have a lot of flavor.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: I really like to this place. I mean it's just a taco trailer but the food was good and hardy. The service was quick. And the guy running the thing was pretty nice.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

press.text: Our latest obsession is this taco truck. Service is always awesome, employees are always pleasant, and service is fast. Today they packed our food [chicken tacos and super carne asada burritos] with everything extra: plenty of red and green salsa, chips and extra grilled onion/jalapeno. Everything was delicious.

faq.q: Can I call ahead and order?
faq.a: Yes! Call us at (707) 334-8381 to order ahead and skip the line.
We're open Monday to Friday, 11 AM to 9 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
Yes, we take cash and cards. A small fee may apply on card payments.
Try the suadero super burrito, the one the San Francisco Chronicle singled out. Our al pastor, lengua, carnitas and shrimp burritos are big favorites too.
Yes, we do catering. Call the truck to ask.
We've got outdoor picnic tables, and parking is mostly on the street.
Friday around 6 PM is our busiest time, with waits up to about 15 minutes.
